reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` flag will be ignored when upgrading to Loki 3.0.0; any configuration using this flag will no longer be honored.

proposed.statement: The CLI flag `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` has been removed from the shipper configuration in Loki 3.0.0.
